# ERC Starting Grant Award

::: {.post-meta}
Sept 03, 2026
:::

`r img_html("news_ercstg", alt = "ERC Starting Grant", class = "post-image", style = "width: 80%; display: block; margin: 0 auto 20px;")`

We are excited to announce that our lab has been awarded an ERC Starting Grant to lead **LIFE** - Bioactive LIpids For Targeting Leukemia Immune Evasion over the next five years. 

LIFE asks how bioactive lipids - a class of signaling metabolites - help leukemia escape immune surveillance and contribute to relapse after allogeneic stem cell transplantation.

- [The news on the University of Basel website](https://www.unibas.ch/en/News-Events/News/Uni-People/ERC-Starting-Grants-2026-University-of-Basel-Aposotolova-Dixon-Li-Nuijsink-Palko-Tepekule.html)
- [ERC Starting Grant results](https://erc.europa.eu/news-events/news/erc-2026-starting-grants-results)
